note: Forbidden: an alternate over an OSPF link whose forward or reverse cost is costed out. A Router-LSA link metric is 16 bits, so the costed-out value is MaxLinkMetric 0xffff (RFC 6987 Section 3). selectLFA (spf/lfa.go) now gates forwardCost and reverseCost on spf.MaxLinkMetric = 0xffff. TestRFC5286CostedOutLinkMetric drives selectLFA with forward cost 0xffff and reverse cost 0xffff (each must return no backup) and with 0xfffe on both (must return one), so a gate on the 24-bit LSInfinity or a missing gate goes red. The older TestRFC5286CostReverseCostGate still injects 0x00ffffff, a value no link carries; it stays true and adds nothing.
